source_summary: hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages (?action=raw wikitext, '==Decks==' tables), fetched 2026-10-09. Card ids from Server/data/dbf-36.6.0.0-20261004 (original collectible id preferred; CORE_/VAN_/HERO_ skins skipped). Cross-checked: Icy Veins / Out of Games / HearthPwn / Fandom (Cloudflare-blocked) list no full boss decks; Out of Games tuning article only says some boss decks were weakened.
